mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exchange_apply (apply_user_id, item_id, owner_user_id, message, apply_status) VALUES (#{applyUserId}, #{itemId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{message}, #{applyStatus})
mapper.select: SELECT e.*, au.username AS apply_username, au.avatar AS apply_user_avatar, au.student_no AS apply_student_no, ou.username AS owner_username, i.item_name, i.images AS item_images FROM exchange_apply e INNER JOIN sys_user au ON e.apply_user_id = au.id INNER JOIN idle_item i ON e.item_id = i.id LEFT JOIN sys_user ou ON e.owner_user_id = ou.id WHERE e.apply_user_id = #{applyUserId} ORDER BY e.create_time DESC
